ac:layout-cell.h1: Invoice Retrieval Sequence and Reuse Assessment
ac:layout-cell.p: Solution summary · Logical specification · API calls and Spain changes
Confluence views: Summary · Required behaviour · Sequences and reuse · API reference

This view assesses the existing E-Invoice API against SPEC016. That predecessor stays unchanged; SPEC025 is the selected source for the stable Confluence overview page. This review adds the view/download scope decision and SPEC042 call details. The supplied guide was first used for France; it does not prove Spain support. No new endpoint or breaking change is established. REF-SCOPE.

Reuse existing Query/Retrieve calls for the customer’s sent and received invoice views. ERP calls the Domain Service – E-Invoice Service through the existing E-Invoice API; the service returns the list or selected-invoice result to the ERP. Assess the existing attachment-download pattern for required user download across public and private platforms. Public collection needs its own Spain discovery/download binding; a product-facing GET does not prove that source integration exists. SPEC026 owns required behaviour and the scope decision. INT-RCV01; REF-BASE/PRODUCT/SCOPE.

tr.td: SPFE required collection, view and user download — Phase 1
Bind public discovery/download to shared capture; qualify list/detail and safe saved-file access through existing APIs.
Show invoices, file roles, gaps and freshness; allow authorised SPFE file download. Product API applicability and source binding remain RET-G01/03/05/06.
Public optional improvements — Phase 1
Assess refresh acceleration and optional notifications separately from required view/download.
Refresh joins existing work. ZIP export remains outside initial scope. RET-G02/09.
External private providers — Phase 2
View and user download required. Reuse list/detail and saved-file access; qualify provider intake.
Qualify source-file acquisition separately from user download. Provider rollout needs RET-G01/02/04; private saved-file access needs RET-G05/10.
Sage private-platform offering — Phase 3
View and user download required. Assess shared view/intake/download reuse and service-chain coverage.
Confirm operator readiness and actual build/contracts before enablement. RET-G01/04/09/10.
Shared processing
Reuse records and duplicate handling. DTS conversion applies only under SPEC026 RCV-06.
UBL 2.5 skips conversion. Qualify Phase 3 conversions separately from source access and ERP receipt. RET-G05/07/09; REF-DTS-SCOPE.
Optional derived files
Assess format=facturx only if selected.
Ordinary capture/read does not generate a hybrid. RET-G08.

ac:layout-cell.p: The SPEC026 source scenarios define original/copy handling and the open private-failure recovery policy. The sequences below add the calls and recovery evidence.

Grey shows documented existing E-Invoice calls. Blue shows proposed Spain binding or a handoff to confirm. Red in SPEC042 marks open evidence. Supplied public SOAP operations are transport evidence; their business formats and running implementation remain unqualified. Arrows show requests and results. A source fetch and a user download are different actions.
Draw.io · PNG.

This existing guide flow explains notification-led file capture. It does not prove private saved-file access or establish a public webhook. Capture is complete only after bytes and evidence are saved consistently. Listing can recover missed notifications within qualified coverage. An error event follows its own action. INT-RCV01 §§1–4; INT-ERR01; RET-G01/02/04.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 2.2 Spain public discovery and separate file recovery
ac:layout-cell.p: Draw.io · PNG.

Automatic collection discovers by presentation date, downloads separately and saves covered progress after source capture/classification. GetInvoices is an additional identity/status check when needed. A query result cannot stand in for a file. SPFE-S03/S08/S12–15; RSD-03–06.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 2.3 Expired links, interrupted capture and stored-file access
ac:layout-cell.p: Draw.io · PNG.

Renew a confirmed expired link for the same invoice/file role; other 403 results need their actual reason. Preserve completed files during partial recovery. After capture, a saved-file request checks current permission and reads saved bytes. Its API remains unconfirmed. INT-RCV01 §4; RSD-04/07.
Draw.io · PNG.

This supporting sequence expands View invoice list, Select and open invoice and Download file from the SPEC026 detailed process. Review and take action branches from Select and open invoice and continues in SPEC029; it does not require Download file.

The SPEC026 §2 customer journey owns the user actions and outcomes. The ERP calls the Domain Service – E-Invoice Service, through the existing E-Invoice API: Query e-invoices (RET-API-01) for the business’s sent/received list, then Retrieve e-invoice (RET-API-02) for the selected invoice. Each service result returns to the ERP before display. Preserve the selected ID, business and source across pages; RET-G01 still qualifies the ID relationship. For Download file, ERP uses a returned attachment link under RET-API-03. When descriptors were omitted or expiry is confirmed, it calls Retrieve with includeAttachments=true for links; the subsequent URL request transfers bytes from the file source. Download is optional and opening does not trigger it. A known qualified ID can still open detail directly; Query can also supply file links. These are existing API capabilities, not extra UI steps. SPEC042 §1 owns the contract limits.

Rendering a readable document is separate from returning detail metadata. Both public and private platforms require saved-file download under SPEC026 §1. Qualify whether the existing downloadUrl identifies the captured source and meets Records controls before using it for this action. An absent readable rendering must not relabel XML or an original file as a PDF. REF-SCOPE; RET-G01/04/05/08/10.
ac:layout-cell.h2: 3 Existing operations and material contract gaps
ac:layout-cell.p: SPEC042 owns RET-API-01–05 request/response detail and examples. This table relates the documented calls to reuse gaps; it does not select Spain endpoint availability.

tr.td: POST /internal/events/subscriptions — INT-RCV01 §1
Event, dataset/source and HTTPS callback scope → subscription (201, labelled 201 OK in guide).
Confirm access, schema/casing, security, safe replay and subscription lifecycle. RET-G01/02.
Received webhook — §2
Event context; subject identifies invoice; nullable data.errorCode.
Verify scope/authenticity and map errors before using the ID. Receipt is not file capture. RET-G02.
Query e-invoices / RET-API-01: GET /datasets/{datasetId}/e-invoices — INT-RCV02; INT-RCV01 §3.2
Optional filters/continuation → paginated data[], nested documents, current status, availableAttachments and file links; no declared status history.
Qualify inbound selection and list-to-detail IDs. The guide's 20-item page/90-day window are not specified in the supplied OpenAPI. RET-G01/03.
Retrieve e-invoice / RET-API-02: GET /datasets/{datasetId}/e-invoices/{e-invoiceId} — INT-RCV03; INT-RCV01 §3.1
Dataset and selected invoice UUID → one data object, status/history and availableAttachments. includeAttachments defaults to true; false omits descriptors/URLs and skips Factur-X generation.
Confirm authoritative ID, source-file roles and Spain scope. RET-G01/04.
File-transfer step: GET {downloadUrl} — INT-RCV01 §4
Follow an attachment link from Retrieve or Query, no Authorization → bytes; expired URL may return 403. No separate Sage invoice endpoint is defined.
Capture promptly; verify content. Re-read details for an expired link. RET-G04/05.
Detail GET with format=facturx — INT-RCV03; INT-RCV01 §§3.1/4
Optional request → generate/persist hybrid or return existing FacturX attachment.
Guide describes Human_Readable; qualify role mapping, generation effects and Spain need. RET-G04/08.
GetRegisteredInvoice / QUERYBYFILTER — SPFE-S03/S15
Presentation-date discovery → up to 1000 results, SECUENCE_ID.
Qualify exact filters/continuation and recipient authority. RET-G06.
GetInvoices / QUERYBYID — SPFE-S03/S14
Up to 1000 identifiers → identity/final-status metadata.
Consultation, not general date discovery or file capture. RET-G06.
DownloadInvoicesByLOC / DOWNLOADBYLOC — SPFE-S03/S13
Qualified locator → files/results; catalogue’s preferred recovery route.
Confirm recipient representation and locator binding. No LOC batch limit inferred. RET-G06.
DownloadInvoicesByID / DOWNLOADBYID — SPFE-S03/S12
ApplicationResponse document references, up to 100 invoices → per-item results.
Qualify exact identity, envelope and partial-failure handling. RET-G06.
SPFE → Sage

The reviewed catalogue and PRE contracts provide query/download operations. No invoice-received webhook, subscription or WebSocket interface is established by this bundle. Sage must initiate discovery and file pulls using this baseline. Automated collection requires a Sage trigger; it is not SPFE push. Absence from this bundle is not proof that no future or separate interface can exist. SPFE-S03 §§6.4–6.7; SPFE-S12–15; REF-EVIDENCE.
France E-Invoice Service → consuming product

INT-RCV01 §§1–4 documents subscription → invoice-received webhook → Retrieve → attachment download. Its Polling section gives list/history polling when webhooks are unavailable. INT-ERR01 records receiving webhook failures. These sources do not prove the deployed schedule, quotas or the complete provider-to-Sage intake design. Do not assume France notifications exist for SPFE.

ac:layout-cell.p: Existing product baseline: PRD211 Product principles 1–2 requires scheduled collection independently of customer activity. Login or refresh may accelerate it. A product-facing Query or Retrieve GET does not establish that Sage makes a fresh SPFE call. REF-PRODUCT; INT-RCV02/03.

Proposed list-open refresh — Architecture decision pending: when a customer opens the invoice list, show captured invoices and collection freshness. If the last successful collection is too old under the selected policy, request or join an earlier pull. Keep captured invoices readable while that work runs; show a pending or failed refresh separately from an empty result. This candidate supplements the scheduled baseline. The freshness threshold, completion update mechanism and any product-to-Sage refresh contract remain unselected. User suggestion, 2 November 2026; RSD-02/03/07; RET-G03.

Architecture, API and Operations must determine the background schedule, list-open trigger, shared limits/concurrency, retry delays, duplicate-request handling and recovery after inactivity or outage. Product supplies the acceptable freshness target. Qualify SPFE limits separately from E-Invoice REST limits: the REST guide's 429/Retry-After behaviour does not establish SPFE throttling. No numeric interval or quota is supplied. RET-G03/06/09.

The list can contain sent and received documents. Confirm inbound/self-billing selection; AP/AR names do not establish Spain mappings. Prove time boundaries, links.next scope, stable ordering, late arrivals and crash recovery before saving progress. The example-only currentStatus/createdAt filter is absent from the filter table. INT-RCV01 §3.2; RET-G01/03.

The 90-day creation window is neither retention nor complete history. Missing older coverage stays visible. No polling cadence/quota is supplied; honour valid Retry-After on 429. Read/acknowledgement side effects and bounded retry remain qualification gates. RET-G02/03/06/09.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 3.2 Identity, files, formats and source conflicts

tr.td: Dataset, invoice and event IDs

Reuse the selected business’s NIF/certificate/authority setup and resolve its authorised dataset/environment. Query/Retrieve authenticate the application using M2M JWT; no NIF/certificate GET parameter is declared. Confirm represented business, partner, environment and historical route. INT-RCV02's list example has different outer data[].id and nested documents[].eInvoiceId values; confirm which binds the detail UUID. INT-RCV03 defines data.id, unlike the older guide table's data.attributes.eInvoiceId. erpInvoiceId is not a universal deduplication key. RET-G01/02.
Subscription casing/security
Resolve Data/Type/Attributes/Scope versus lowercase examples, opaqueToken/opaquetoken, and subscription versus notification event names. Use one selected schema. RET-G02.
Attachment availability

availableAttachments is a count, not a descriptor or immutable file ID. Retrieve includeAttachments=false omits descriptors and URL/Factur-X generation even when the count is positive. Request included links only when needed; preserve invoice/file binding. Current 13 November snapshot; RET-G04/05/08.
Attachment roles
Preserve Undefined, UBL, Human_Readable, Original_Document, FacturX from INT-RCV02/03. UBL derived from Factur-X is not automatically the exchanged original. RET-G04.
Spain format and identity

Qualify public UBL 2.5, rectification, the SPEC026 copy-indicator table and seller/number/date identity. The flag classifies a file; it does not establish an automatic content-comparison capability. Do not relabel example UBL 2.1; resolve ProfileID against final Annex I BT-23. SPFE-S02/S08/S09; RET-G06/07.
Extracted values

Tax totals/breakdowns are absent from the guide’s extracted response. Read the required values from the checked structured file. For conversion under SPEC026 RCV-06, prove tax/extension preservation and match each result to its source and mapping version. RET-G07; REF-DTS-SCOPE.

ac:layout-cell.h3: 3.3 Shared access, file safety and records
ac:layout-cell.p: Check current client/action authority on source calls, link renewal and saved reads. Keep temporary URLs out of saved records, logs and events; do not forward Sage bearer tokens to file hosts. Qualify allowed destinations/redirects and verify file role, content, size/type and integrity. RET-G01/04/05.

Renewal does not prove immutable content. Stable attachment identity/version/hash and range/resume are missing from the guide. Partial files remain incomplete. Saved reads use qualified records permissions, retention/holds and historical access; missing/corrupt content opens a records incident. Ordinary reads do not refetch, generate Factur-X or create buyer acceptance. RSD-04/07/09; RET-G04/05/08.

A provider notification/reference requires the provider’s qualified file download. Complete supplied bytes avoid another provider fetch. The product-facing detail/downloadUrl flow does not prove how Sage obtained those bytes from B2B Router or another provider. Qualify provider file roles, original provenance, authority, renewal, acknowledgement and history separately. PRI-03; RRI-A01–03; REF-PRIVATE; RET-G01/04/05.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 3.5 FR attempt errors and lifecycle separation
ac:layout-cell.p: Use data.attributes.history[].operationStatus and history[].errorCode for the relevant attempt; currentStatus has neither. Preserve IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, ERROR and required data.meta; do not assume history ordering. INT-ERR01.

tr.td: Notification failure — ERR-RECEIVING-DOC-001
Observe the platform-owned retry/support path. Do not recapture to generate another notification.
Missing key / duplicate — ERR-RECEIVING-DOC-002, ERR-RECEIVING-NOT-25
Qualify key ownership; check the existing transaction and file results. Do not invent an idempotency header for GET or a new invoice POST.
Configuration/verification — ERR-RECEIVING-NOT-001, -007, -008
Correct the named problem or use support; do not treat it as generic safe retry.
Retrieval, creation, attachment or delivery failure — -003, -006, -009, -010, -016, -019
Follow platform retry ownership and preserve completed stages. -016 concerns a lifecycle document, not original-invoice capture.
Unknown/unused code or exhausted policy
Keep exact safe evidence and an owner; never default to success. -014/-020 are unused; -011 describes a temporary workaround, not DTS build proof.

ac:layout-cell.p: The source dictionary retains all 45 codes, including unpadded ERR-RECEIVING-NOT-22–-25. A final ERROR ends that attempt; later retries need separate correlation. Code-specific six-day support guidance is not a Spain legal deadline. Receiving errors cannot create payment/rejection/cancellation reports; SPEC029 owns Annex II. INT-ERR01; SPFE-S22.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 3.6 Who sends what and what comes back

tr.td: ERP/product ↔ Domain Service – E-Invoice Service, via existing E-Invoice API

RET-API-01/02: authorised datasetId, sent/received scope and selected invoice ID → list/detail results, attachment availability and included links; history is in Retrieve. The ERP displays the service result.
Confirm Spain support, direction/self-billing selection and NIF/dataset/address binding. The GETs use M2M JWT, not certificate/NIF parameters. RET-G01/03.
E-Invoice Service → SPFE
RET-SPFE-01/02: recipient role, qualified presentation-date filters or invoice identities → discovery/status metadata and continuation evidence.
Required public collection; exact filter encoding and continuation remain RET-G06. Metadata is not a file.
E-Invoice Service → SPFE
RET-SPFE-03/04: qualified locator or invoice references → source invoices and distinct failed-item results.
Required source capture; preserve operation, item identity and exact bytes. RET-G04/06.
Product/file consumer → file source
RET-API-03: returned temporary URL → file bytes, or a classified refusal.
Candidate for required public/private user download only after saved-source binding passes RET-G04/05; private coverage also needs RET-G10.
E-Invoice Service / private integration → provider
Selected notification/fetch or supplied-file contract → verified source capture and intake result.
Required private view and user download need qualified intake and saved-file access. Exact provider contract and transfer mode remain RET-G01/04; private download coverage remains RET-G10.
Product → view/records capability — proposed
Current client/invoice/file context → readable information or permitted saved bytes, with access result.
Identify existing implementation first. No new view, render or saved-read endpoint is established. RET-G05/08/09.

tr.th: Evidence required before enabling the affected capability

tr.td: ret-g01RET-G01 — Architecture, API, Identity, Tax/Connections, Routing, Product/Compliance

Open: how are the business/NIF, dataset(s), public/private platform connections, credential references and action authority linked for retrieval? Confirm one-to-one and one-to-many relationships with onboarding GAP-01, GAP-02 and GAP-06. No NIF/certificate lookup key or one dataset per NIF is selected. Supply the agreed resource model, source-qualified IDs, lookup contract and worked mappings for a business with multiple platforms and a reused certificate, plus an accountant acting for different clients. Prove current/historical authority, partner and environment isolation, and safe handling of a missing or unavailable lookup. RRI-Q01–03; RCV-Q02/12.
RET-G02 — API, Events, Security, Integration
Selected schemas/casing, authentication, event/attempt IDs, replay, errors, subscription lifecycle and read/acknowledgement effects. RCV-Q01/05.
RET-G03 — Architecture, API, Retrieval, Operations; Product for freshness

Decide the pull policy in §3.1: background cadence, proposed list-open acceleration, freshness target/threshold, refresh result/contract, source versus REST quotas, concurrency and retry delays. Prove inbound/date selection, pagination, stable progress, late/older history and visible gap recovery. Confirm actual France mechanisms before reusing them. RSD-G01/06/07.
RET-G04 — Integration/provider, Records, Security

Exact source/file roles, content binding, link renewal, partial/required file sets and safe transfer. Prove the copy-only behaviour, including why original retrieval is pending and the supported recovery source. A faithful copy does not prove current receiving readiness. RCV-Q01/03; NOTE003 Q14.2/5.
RET-G05 — Records, Product, Compliance

Existing view/saved-read contracts and builds, source/file-role binding, current permission, integrity, retention/holds, restore/export and historical access beyond the list window. RSD-G03/04; RCV-Q06.
RET-G06 — Spain connector, API, Identity/Compliance
Public filters/MessageProperties, SECUENCE_ID, LOC/ID/NIU encoding, authority, read effects and pending business formats. SPFE-Q06/09/12–14/17.
RET-G07 — Validation, Receiving/Product; DTS for RCV-06

Prove Spain format, correction and copy rules, tax/extensions, country isolation and support. For RCV-06 only, prove the Phase 3 non-UBL 2.5 → UBL 2.5 conversion build/mapping and match delayed results to their source/version. RSD-G08; RCV-Q03/04/07/09; REF-DTS-SCOPE.
RET-G08 — Product, API, Format/Records

Qualified product display/readable representations for required public/private view; need and contract for optional Factur-X generation. Confirm unavailable/unsupported renderings, access, concurrency and derived-file provenance. RRI-Q02; RCV-Q06.
RET-G09 — Receiving, Product, Operations

Durable capture/classification, product receipts, retry limits/escalation, per-client work, measured targets, build/run owner and existing-country regression. Confirm repeat-intake handling and content-comparison coverage under SPEC026 §3.2’s capability limitation. Cover copy-first/later-original arrival without duplicate ERP delivery, lost decision/payment history or duplicate reports. NOTE003 Q14.3–6 retains open action and status-matching decisions; file access does not authorise commands. RCV-Q08/11/13; RRI-Q03.
RET-G10 — Product, Compliance, Records, provider integration

Qualify required private user download for each enabled external provider and the Sage offering: captured-file coverage, original/copy/derived roles, current permission, retention/holds, historical access and failure recovery. Link actual build/contracts and acceptance evidence; a missing provider contract is a delivery gap, not optional scope. RRI-Q02; REF-SCOPE.

ac:layout-cell.p: For each reuse candidate, identify the actual capability/build, Spain changes, owner and proof. A reusable pattern is not evidence that production code supports it. SPEC026 recovery defines the safe outcomes.
These checks supplement SPEC026; none is claimed as executed implementation testing.

tr.td: RET-API-A01

Wrong business/dataset/country/environment and revoked grants are denied on calls, renewal and saved reads. Use the worked mappings approved under RET-G01 to check multiple platforms with a reused certificate and separate accountant clients. A missing or unavailable setup lookup keeps affected work pending; it must not select another business or infer a new dataset/connection. RSD-A01/08/13; RRI-A07/08; SPFE-S02 Article 11.
RET-API-A02
Authenticate/error-check webhooks; recover duplicates, reordering, missed events and lost subscription responses. Verify receipt/attempt meaning. RRI-A02/04/09; RCV-A20.
RET-API-A03

Scheduled pulls continue without customer sessions. If list-open acceleration is selected, fresh data avoids an unnecessary pull; stale data requests or joins one within the qualified limits. Concurrent viewers do not duplicate collection; captured content stays readable during refresh or source failure. Prove recovery after inactivity/outage. Over 20 items, mixed directions, date boundaries, repeated pages, concurrent arrivals, crashes and older-than-90-day work retain complete or visibly incomplete coverage. RSD-A03/07/10; RRI-A04; REF-PRODUCT; RET-G03.
RET-API-A04

Notification-only versus supplied-file modes, missing/expired/refused/partial files, safe renewal and required/optional sets preserve good files and source identity. No bearer forwarding or unsafe access. RRI-A01–03/06; RSD-A06/09/14.
RET-API-A05
Safe saved reads survive mapping/product failure, holds and provider changes; no refetch or silent disposal. RSD-A04/11; RRI-A05/08; RCV-A23/24.
RET-API-A06
Public date discovery, continuation and separate LOC/ID downloads handle authority/partial failure and possible read effects. SPFE-S03/S08/S12–15; RSD-SPFE-A01–03; RSD-A16.
RET-API-A07

Prove the RCV-06 phase/format cases in SPEC026 §6, copy equivalence, tax precision and correction/extension handling. For a selected Phase 3 conversion, prove the actual DTS result and source/version link. No technical error creates a business report. RCV-A13/16–18/22; RRI-A10; REF-DTS-SCOPE.
RET-API-A08
Ordinary reads do not generate hybrids; optional generation preserves source, access, provenance and independent failure. RRI-A06/07; RCV-I05.
RET-API-A09

Crash/lost receipt, notification failure after capture, duplicate transaction and platform retries cannot duplicate invoices or repeat good files. Stop exhausted retries with an owned unresolved case. RCV-A14/15/28/31; RSD-A02; INT-ERR01.
RET-API-A10

Prove the SPEC026 §2 list → selected invoice → optional download journey, including permission changes between actions and incomplete/denied results. Prove ERP ↔ Domain Service Query/Retrieve calls and results for sent/received views. Prove Query returns a paginated list and a selected result maps to the correct Retrieve detail/history; do not equate outer and nested IDs without evidence. Both can supply file links. Check the default includeAttachments=true, false with a positive count, count zero, and missing/expired links followed by Retrieve with included attachments. False must skip URL and Factur-X generation. A further URL GET obtains bytes from the file source. INT-RCV02/03; RET-G01. Required public/private view enforces client/invoice permission and distinguishes source/file roles. Missing content stays visibly incomplete. SPFE shows freshness. Each enabled public/private platform offers authorised saved-file download during mapping/product failure or source outage. Check private originals and captured public originals/copies, denied access, expired-link renewal, interrupted transfers and missing/corrupt saved files. No view creates buyer acceptance. SPEC026 §2/§6; REF-SCOPE.
